"accessories/headdress/left_ribbon_streamer": "角色左侧（画面右侧）的长飘带垂在身体外侧。浅蓝白色深浅是本体渐变与阴影，参考图未见背景透出，整组不设透明度。", "accessories/headdress/right_ribbon_streamer": "角色右侧（画面左侧）的长飘带经过右手附近时位于手后。浅蓝白色深浅是本体渐变与阴影，参考图未见背景透出，整组不设透明度。"}}
svg.title: Jianma2D — fresh semantic block-layer draft
svg.desc: Step 3 only. 43 independently editable leaf groups; opaque solid diagnostic colors; source-derived visible contours and complete inferred hidden continuations. No garment group. No masks or raster images.

g.title: accessories/headdress/left_ribbon_streamer
g.desc: Opaque whole opposite ribbon and hanging jewel string.

g.title: accessories/headdress/right_ribbon_streamer
g.desc: Whole opaque ribbon plus jewel string. Hidden span behind right hand supplied as continuous broad ribbon, not a visible fragment group.

g.title: accessories/headdress/halo_arc
g.desc: Native opaque thin arc behind bun.

g.title: body/neck
g.desc: Complete neck under the face and rear hair; chest join is covered by torso.

g.title: body/torso
g.desc: Smooth complete torso reconstructed under temporary garment; garment neckline, straps and seams are omitted.

g.title: body/arms/left_arm/left_upper_arm
g.desc: Source outer shoulder/elbow with complete inner upper-arm continuation.

g.title: body/arms/left_arm/left_forearm
g.desc: Complete forearm with joint overlap.

g.title: body/arms/left_arm/left_hand
g.desc: Source skin contour preserves whole palm and all visible fingers.

g.title: body/arms/right_arm/right_upper_arm
g.desc: Outer shoulder/elbow sampled from current source foreground. Upper inner continuation ends beneath torso.

g.title: body/arms/right_arm/right_forearm
g.desc: Complete forearm with small hidden overlap at elbow and wrist.

g.title: body/arms/right_arm/right_hand
g.desc: Source skin contour preserves whole palm and every visible finger; no invented polygon finger silhouette.

g.title: body/lower_body/pelvis
g.desc: Complete pelvic core beneath garment; overlaps natural thigh roots. No separate garment asset.

g.title: body/lower_body/left_leg/left_thigh
g.desc: Outer hip and thigh source-derived. Hidden root is extended into pelvis.

g.title: body/lower_body/left_leg/left_lower_leg
g.desc: Complete source calf/shin from overlapping knee to ankle.

g.title: body/lower_body/left_leg/left_foot
g.desc: Complete source foot and toes; jewelry stays a separate upper layer.

g.title: body/lower_body/right_leg/right_thigh
g.desc: Outer hip and thigh source-derived. Hidden root is extended up inside pelvis.

g.title: body/lower_body/right_leg/right_lower_leg
g.desc: Complete source calf/shin from overlapping knee to ankle.

g.title: body/lower_body/right_leg/right_foot
g.desc: Complete source foot and toes; jewelry stays a separate upper layer.

g.title: head/ears/left_ear
g.desc: Whole auricle continued beneath front hair.

g.title: head/ears/right_ear
g.desc: Whole auricle continued beneath front hair.

g.title: head/face/face_base
g.desc: Visible cheek/jaw curve constrained by independently traced source target. Forehead and lateral regions behind bangs are complete inferred continuation.

g.title: head/hair/face_framing_hair/left_face_framing_lock
g.desc: Continuous full lock through the region hidden by bangs. Curled free tip preserved.

g.title: head/hair/face_framing_hair/right_face_framing_lock
g.desc: Continuous full lock through the region hidden by bangs. Curled free tip preserved.

g.title: head/hair/bangs/right_bang
g.desc: Complete major front-hair mass; separated from side locks. Source hair internal striations reserved for refinement.

g.title: head/face/eyes/left_eye
g.desc: Single filled whole-eye base, including connected outer lash mass. Source left eye = screen right.

g.title: head/face/eyes/right_eye
g.desc: Single filled whole-eye base, including connected outer lash mass; no clip/mask or thin bridging. Source right eye = screen left.

g.title: accessories/headdress/central_crest
g.desc: Whole flower crown silhouette, central gem and wing petals retained as one large group.

g.title: accessories/headdress/left_filigree_wing
g.desc: Source foreground vectorized, retaining openwork holes.

g.title: accessories/headdress/right_filigree_wing
g.desc: Source foreground vectorized with native openwork holes; upper inner occlusion continued by intact object contour.

g.title: accessories/earrings/right_earring
g.desc: Complete ear chain, jewel and shoulder-length drop; internal facet detail deferred.
